title: Counit scalar maps respect ordinary etale direct-image composition
statement:
Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings. All schemes and morphisms below are arbitrary [def-pc-scheme]. Write $D_R(T)=D(T_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ for the ordinary unbounded derived category of constant-ring module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], $Q_T=(-)\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and $u_R^*$ for exact inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Use the canonical K-flat scalar/pullback isomorphism $\lambda_u:u_B^*Q_T\cong Q_Wu_A^*$ for $u:W\to T$ [def-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-iso], the coefficient-change form of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Use the canonical derived adjunction $u_R^*\dashv Ru_{*,R}$ [def-kun-projection-formula-map]. Define $\chi_{u,E}:Q_TRu_{*,A}E\to Ru_{*,B}Q_WE$ to have adjunct $Q_W(\varepsilon_{u,A,E})\circ\lambda_{u,Ru_{*,A}E}$, where $\varepsilon_{u,A}$ is the counit. Let $X\xrightarrow rY\xrightarrow sZ$. Write $\kappa_R:R(sr)_{*,R}\cong Rs_{*,R}Rr_{*,R}$ for the K-injective-normalized direct-image composition [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. For every $M\in D_A(X)$,
$$\kappa_{B,Q_XM}\circ\chi_{sr,M}=Rs_{*,B}(\chi_{r,M})\circ\chi_{s,Rr_{*,A}M}\circ Q_Z(\kappa_{A,M}).$$
Under the canonical identity direct-image comparisons $\chi_{\mathrm{id}}$ is the identity. No properness, Noetherian hypothesis, boundedness, flatness, or invertibility of $\chi$ is asserted.

Transport its inverse Hom equivalence from the total left-derived pullbacks to the exact levelwise pullbacks through leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory. The formula is obtained by expanding the composite counit of [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction] and naturality of the two comparison isomorphisms. Expand the transported scalar comparisons and counits; naturality and inverse cancellation identify the resulting expression with step 1. Injectivity of the inverse Hom equivalence gives equality of the transported arrows, and cancellation of scalar extension of the forward A compositor proves composition.

Identify the canonical derived identity counit with the canonical direct-image identity isomorphism: the ordinary identity counit has this property, and mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction_counit_app_of_iso transports it to exact derived functors. The universal right-derived comparison identifies derivation of lowerStarId with the displayed identity map. Naturality and inverse cancellation undo the transport of the left and right adjoints. Finally the defining mate counit equation, using the counit form of the Hom equivalence [lem-weil-pbc-adjunct-counit-identity], of [def-pur-etale-scalar-mate] turns the scalar identity normalization into the required equality.
